rule_en: Every turn a SET of 3+ fires once: all enemies take 40/65/90% of the SET's base total (max 20).

awaken.rule_en: The SET fires a second time when you use its last die, and the blast pierces enemy Shield.

rule_en: A clean Gamble (2+ dice, none Cracked): every SET this turn +0.35 (max +0.60). Gamble Crack chance 15% (normally 30%).

awaken.rule_en: Once per turn, when a Gamble Cracks, the Cracked dice are rerolled at once for free.

rule_en: When the first roll of a turn makes a SET: +1 mana. Overcast costs only 1.

awaken.rule_en: Overcast can be used twice per turn (the second costs 2 mana).

rule_en: A SET with 3+ dice of the same class +0.40; a SET without that -0.25.
cost_en: A SET that misses the class condition -0.25.

awaken.rule_en: First turn of each fight, Axies of the same class roll the same part (up to a SET of four).

rule_en: You may Hold 2 dice; a Held die used next turn gets +0.50.

awaken.rule_en: Once per turn a carried Held die joins any SET as a Temp Face, free of mana (up to a SET of four).

rule_en: A SET of three gives no bonus; a SET of four or five gets +0.40.
cost_en: A SET of three loses its bonus.

awaken.rule_en: Each turn with a SET of four or more, roll one bonus die to use this turn (it does not join the SET).
